name: iraop
description: MCP-SSE bridge from OpenClaw to the iraop (Sequoia) documentation retrieval agent.

baseUrl.description: iraop MCP SSE endpoint URL. Defaults to http://iraop:8000/mcp/sse.

timeoutMs.description: Per-tool-call timeout in milliseconds. Default 240000 (4 min) so deep queries have headroom.

subagentEventsUrl.description: Optional UI endpoint that receives live iraop subagent events.

baseUrl.label: iraop MCP SSE URL
baseUrl.help: Full URL to iraop's /mcp/sse endpoint. In-cluster: http://iraop:8000/mcp/sse

timeoutMs.label: Tool-call timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.help: iraop's deep-research agent can take 30-120s per query; 240000 gives headroom for deep mode.

subagentEventsUrl.label: Subagent events URL
subagentEventsUrl.help: UI endpoint for rendering IRA as a read-only subagent panel.
